source.title: Changes to WCA Head-to-Head Format (April 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

Over the past few months, we have hosted several competitions featuring the new Head-to-Head format in the 3x3, 3x3 One-Handed, 3x3 Blindfolded and 4x4 events. Based on extensive feedback received from the community in-person and via livestreams on the [WCA Youtube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@WorldCubeAssociationOfficial), the following changes have been made:

* The 3x3 Fewest Moves and 3x3 Multi-Blind events have been added to the list of Head-to-Head events.
* The restriction on competitions not running for longer than 16 hours without a break of at least 9 hours will be removed for competitions featuring the Head-to-Head format.
* Minor changes regarding the organisation of Head-to-Head competitions.

The decision to include 3x3 Fewest Moves and 3x3 Multi-Blind was a decision to unite them with the other 3x3-based events as part of this opportunity. This decision was made following consultations with world-class cubers in these events, who agreed with the public feedback that these events being omitted was confusing, and that they would love the opportunity for their main events to be given a spotlight on the international stage.

We are confident that these changes will substantially improve the experience for both competitors and spectators of a WCA Head-to-Head competition. 

For more information regarding these changes, please read our [public explainer document here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/11deVZ2BePo-zepsLxe3o0LOUKKVN6rJw/view?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 一对一赛制调整（2026 年 4 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

过去几个月，我们在多场比赛中试行了新的一对一赛制，涉及三阶、三阶单手、三阶盲拧和四阶项目。结合现场观众以及 [WCA YouTube 频道](https://www.youtube.com/@WorldCubeAssociationOfficial)直播观众的大量反馈，我们作出以下调整：

* 将三阶最少步和三阶多盲加入可采用一对一赛制的项目。
* 对于设有一对一赛制的比赛，取消“连续赛程不得超过 16 小时，之后须至少休息 9 小时”的限制。
* 对一对一比赛的组织方式作出小幅调整。

加入三阶最少步和三阶多盲，是希望借此机会让它们与其他三阶类项目一同参与。我们在作出决定前征询了这两个项目的世界顶尖选手。他们认同公众的反馈，认为此前没有纳入这两个项目令人费解，也希望自己主攻的项目能有机会在国际舞台上受到更多关注。

我们相信，这些调整能显著改善 WCA 一对一比赛的参赛和观赛体验。

有关调整的更多信息，请参阅[公开说明文件](https://drive.google.com/file/d/11deVZ2BePo-zepsLxe3o0LOUKKVN6rJw/view?usp=sharing)。
